content:
i think majority of us would agree that the 10x + hp inflation from alert 5 to madness is not an improvement from the old dtide. 

though some players would rather have hp inflation as a lesser “evil” to the other debuffs you suggested in that regard. since debuffs like -arithmetic bricks a lot of teams. 

personally, i think inflating numbers is never the way to go. your suggestions are in the right “direction” at least in principal (making stages harder while minimally involving inflating hp/dmg)

with the current state of dtide, units with hp% dmg and hyper scaling (base damage / str bonus / final dmg) are heavily favoured for madness difficulties. that’s not to say other units can’t clear, it just takes a lot more, a lot more. 

on madness, in its current state i think it’s an unnecessary turn rewind reliant time sink. 

most whales do not even push for 500 score and above, and those that do either have an ginormous invested account, or have too much time on their hands spending >20hrs and more for all their runs
thread_title: Suggestion For A Better Madness Mechanic

content:
—
to take some inspiration from limbus company & chaos zero nightmare, some ways to increase stage difficulties could be 

- disallowing / limiting DR procs

- disallowing / limiting turn rewind & restart battles 

- disallowing / limiting relics, for eg, u have to “ban” X amount of relics for more points, or use up to X amount of relic capacity 

- adding new mechanics mobs/elites/boss, for example, letting mobs get counter when they normally dont. or adding a berserk / enraged state if u do not follow a certain mechanic or do something wrong. 

- enemies get X amount of shield / healing every turn. 

- random encounter pop ups, in limbus mirror dungeon, there is a chance of getting “invaded” by a random boss. this could be very interesting if implemented in dtide. where a weaker boss could appear in an elite stage.

- stages that scale with your average team lvl, so say if your forbidden lore / average level of units is 90, all enemies and mobs will be that corresponding level. and u get a corresponding multiplier for how difficult it scaled.
